g.title: Acid-catalyzed hydration event 1
g.desc: CH₃CH=CH₂ + H₃O⁺ → (CH₃)₂CH⁺ + H₂O Alkene π pair → hydronium H; acid O–H pair → O. Terminal carbon becomes CH3.

g.text: Alkene π pair → hydronium H; acid O–H pair → O. Terminal carbon becomes CH3.
Original structural mechanism · 2-electron curved arrows · 2D depiction, not a calculated trajectory.

g.title: Acid-catalyzed hydration event 2
g.desc: (CH₃)₂CH⁺ + H₂O → (CH₃)₂CHOH₂⁺ Water O → secondary cation; protonated 2-propanol forms.

g.text: Water O → secondary cation; protonated 2-propanol forms.
Original structural mechanism · 2-electron curved arrows · 2D depiction, not a calculated trajectory.

g.title: Acid-catalyzed hydration event 3
g.desc: (CH₃)₂CHOH₂⁺ + H₂O → (CH₃)₂CHOH + H₃O⁺ Water → oxonium H; oxonium O–H pair → O; hydronium is regenerated.

g.text: Water → oxonium H; oxonium O–H pair → O; hydronium is regenerated.
Original structural mechanism · 2-electron curved arrows · 2D depiction, not a calculated trajectory.
